description: Tonight, with 49 days left until Election Day in the 49th state, lifelong Alaskan Mary Peltola fired up volunteers in Anchorage to talk to their neighbors about her Alaska first campaign to fix the rigged system in DC, lower costs, and put Alaska first.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Alaskans for Mary
title: PHOTOS: Mary Peltola Rallies Fired-Up Volunteers at Anchorage Field Office - Mary Peltola | Fish, Family, Freedom.
